title: Cantaloupe and Star Anise Sorbet
changes_from_base: Ripe cantaloupe steeped with whole star anise replaces the mango and lime.
summary: Very ripe cantaloupe steeped with whole star anise gives a sweet, fragrant orange sorbet with a gentle liquorice note.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Peel and seed the melon, cut into chunks and process until smooth; you should have about 900 ml.

steps.title: Steep
steps.text: Put the purée in the saucepan with the star anise, sugar, corn syrup and water and warm on medium-low, stirring, only until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Take off the heat and leave for 2 h at room temperature so the anise flavours the melon.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Press through the sieve, getting out as much juice as you can, then chill until cold.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min and freeze for at least 2 h.

tips: The riper the melon, the better; it should smell strongly sweet.
Leave the anise in longer for a stronger flavour.
Keep the star anise and use it again in a syrup or tea.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
